The Gram factorization makes K_t compact self-adjoint positive with strictly positive kernel and simple dominating Perron eigenvalue. Similarity and integration of eigenfunctions yields g''+t g'+λ^{-1}g=0, g(0)=0,g'(1)=0. Substituting u=exp(tx/2)g gives the lowest Robin mode, k cot k=t/2 for t<2 and κ coth κ=t/2 for t>2, with λ=1 at t=2. At t=0, λ(0)=4/π². Independent 95-node Nyström eigenvalue estimates at t=-1,0,1,2,4 agreed with root formulas within 1.6e-5; symbolic local root expansion checked separately.
